channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] OneDrive: Discover Copilot actions in File Preview
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] OneDrive will show Copilot actions when previewing files, offering prompts for document summarization and FAQs. This change affects users working with files in OneDrive and SharePoint. (GA: April CY2026) — OneDrive, SharePoint

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot processing content with sensitivity labels supports all storage locations
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention policy will now prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, regardless of where the files are stored. This change affects all users utilizing Copilot with sensitive content. (GA: April CY2026) — Excel, Microsoft 365, PowerPoint, Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Real-time voice interactions in a podcast in Word
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] In Word, users can now interact in real time with podcasts created by Copilot, allowing voice questions while listening. This enhances the audio experience for users. (GA: April CY2026) — Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
item.description: [NEW] Microsoft Teams will allow users to test their microphone and speakers before joining a meeting. This feature helps ensure audio clarity for participants. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
item.description: [NEW] PowerPoint users can now select their preferred image model, such as OpenAI’s GPT Image, for creating and editing images with Copilot. This change affects users working with presentations. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
item.description: [NEW] PowerPoint users can now select their preferred image model, such as OpenAI’s GPT Image, for creating and editing images with Copilot. This change affects users working with presentations. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Find meetings based on topics and keywords
item.description: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot will help users find meetings based on topics and keywords from meeting data like chat and transcription. This feature is useful for users managing multiple meetings. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Exclude modern groups / include dynamic security groups support for sensitivity label policies
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Admins can now exclude modern groups and include dynamic security groups in sensitivity label policies. This change impacts IT admins managing data protection policies. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Explain slide selection during PowerPoint Live
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot will enhance PowerPoint Live by explaining selected slide text during meetings. This feature impacts users participating in PowerPoint Live sessions. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Engage Event Broadcast, Meetings and custom events with moderated feed, annoynmous posting on web & mobile
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Viva Engage will enhance event broadcasting with moderated feeds and anonymous posting options for attendees. This affects event organizers and participants in large-scale events. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Engage Event Analytics
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] New analytics features are being added to Microsoft Viva Engage Events to enhance user insights. This affects users utilizing Viva for event management. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] The Microsoft 365 admin center will now support Organizational Messages for Hybrid-joined Devices. This change affects IT admins managing hybrid environments. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Share agents to Teams
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Users can now share their agents with Microsoft Teams, including notifications to team channels. This change affects users collaborating within Teams. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Expand to Full Event Details on iPad
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook on iPad now allows users to expand calendar events to full-screen for better visibility and editing options. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Experts & verified answers in communities in Engage and Teams for iOS & Android
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] In the Engage app for Teams and Android, community experts can endorse and verify answers, receiving special labels for their contributions. This change affects users of the Engage app. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Engage community membership management in Teams for iOS & Android
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Community admins in Teams for iOS and Android can now manage community membership by adding or removing members. This change affects community administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: See progress when running rules manually in the new Outlook for Windows and Web
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook will show a visual progress indicator when running rules manually, helping users track the action's status. (GA: December CY2025) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Knowledge Agent
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] The Knowledge Agent in Microsoft 365 simplifies SharePoint content management by automating metadata and improving compliance. This change affects users managing SharePoint content. (GA: January CY2026) — SharePoint, SharePoint Syntex, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Camera view switching in multi-camera Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] In Teams Rooms on Windows, users can switch camera views during meetings using the participant panel or touch board. This feature impacts users in multi-camera setups. (GA: January CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Expand and collapse folders when moving emails
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook now allows users to expand and collapse folder trees when moving emails, improving navigation in large folder structures. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: November CY2025) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Organizers reply privately to individuals
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Viva Engage will allow event organizers to privately respond to individual attendees, enhancing communication for sensitive inquiries. This impacts event organizers and participants. (GA: October CY2025) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Allow/disable reactions in Engage events
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Organizers of Engage events can now disable reactions, preventing attendees from using them during discussions and comments. (GA: June CY2025) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Anonymous comments in Engage events
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Engage events will allow anonymous comments, promoting open discussions while keeping user identities hidden. (GA: June CY2025) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Purview: File Creation/Modification conditions in DLP for Sharepoint/OneDrive and AutoLabelling
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP now allows admins to set policies based on file creation and modification dates in SharePoint and OneDrive. This change enhances data protection for organizations. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with the model of your choice in PowerPoint
item.description: PowerPoint users with Microsoft 365 Copilot can now choose between different AI models, including Open AI and Anthropic, for editing presentations. This affects users utilizing Copilot features. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Security Store now available within Purview DLP to browse, purchase, and enable partner integrations
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP integrates the Microsoft Security Store, allowing admins to discover and manage partner integrations directly within the DLP experience. This simplifies procurement for enhanced data security. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Admin setting for simpler meeting passcodes (numeric‑only)
item.description: Admins can enable a setting in Teams to generate numeric-only passcodes for meetings, with a warning about potential security risks. This impacts tenant admins and meeting organizers. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Attendee capacity packs for Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will offer attendee capacity packs, enabling event organizers to increase attendance limits for Teams events. This change impacts event organizers. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Video recap in Teams
item.description: Teams will now include video recaps of meetings, providing narrated highlights and key moments from recorded sessions. This feature affects all Teams users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
item.description: Outlook's Copilot Chat will be accessible in shared and delegate mailboxes for users with appropriate permissions. This affects users managing shared mailboxes. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
item.description: Users can now print calendar events from the new Outlook and Teams, with options to show or hide attendee lists. This change affects all calendar users. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Spoken language detection is now automatic
item.description: Microsoft Teams will automatically detect spoken languages during meetings, removing the need for manual selection. This change affects all Teams users utilizing live captions and transcripts. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
item.description: Outlook admins can now set a default tenant-wide policy for using commas to separate recipients in Mail Compose and Reply settings. This affects all Outlook users. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Additional Diagnostics for Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection
item.description: Microsoft Purview will provide additional diagnostics for Data Loss Prevention, helping users identify sensitive information and applied policies in documents. This impacts users managing sensitive data. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: Draft emails using saved email snippets with Quick Parts for Outlook for Windows and web
item.description: Outlook for Windows and web now supports Quick Parts, allowing users to save and reuse email snippets for faster message drafting. This feature benefits all Outlook users. (GA: February CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Insert Graphic
item.description: A new Graphics button in Outlook for Windows and web will allow users to insert emojis, stock photos, and stickers into messages. This change affects all users composing messages. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Notes now available for instant meetings
item.description: Teams meeting Notes, powered by Loop, are now available for instant meetings, allowing collaborative note-taking. This feature affects all users participating in Teams meetings. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Context preservation in Teams
item.description: Teams will automatically restore your workspace layout and selected messages when returning to a conversation shortly after leaving. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Planner: Planner Agent in group-based basic plans
item.description: The Planner Agent will be available for M365 Copilot licensed users in all group-based Planner plans, including basic plans. This impacts users utilizing Planner for task management. (GA: March CY2026) — Planner, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone user multi-line
item.description: Teams Phone will allow administrators to assign up to 10 phone numbers to a single user, enhancing call management. This affects Teams Phone users and administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Endpoint DLP Device Status API
item.description: The Endpoint DLP Device Status API allows customers to access device health details directly in their BI tools, streamlining reporting processes. This impacts IT admins managing data loss prevention. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Consult and merge a PSTN caller through DTMF
item.description: Teams meeting organizers can now consult and merge PSTN callers during meetings, even when they require DTMF navigation. This feature affects users who organize meetings with PSTN callers. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Unread News Notifications in Connections
item.description: The rollout of unread news notifications in the Connections app has been delayed. Users will eventually receive weekly notifications linking to missed SharePoint news. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft SharePoint: New web part for FAQs
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part, which helps content owners curate FAQs using Microsoft 365 Copilot, is still in development. This affects content managers in SharePoint. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Apply sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions in Office for the web in Microsoft 365
item.description: Office for the web will support applying sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions, enhancing data protection. This change affects users managing sensitive information. (GA: April CY2026) — Excel, Microsoft Purview, PowerPoint, Word

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
item.description: Microsoft Purview will introduce a feature to test files against sensitive information classifiers, helping users identify sensitive content. This affects users managing data classification. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can edit your document in PowerPoint
item.description: Copilot in PowerPoint will enable users to create and edit presentations through natural conversation. This feature is available to Copilot Chat users without a Copilot license. (GA: February CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will expand to safeguard prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot that contain sensitive data. This impacts organizations using Copilot. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot
item.description: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot will assist employees with common HR and IT questions and tasks. This affects employees using Copilot for self-service. (GA: November CY2025) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Exchange: High Volume Email for Microsoft 365
item.description: Exchange will introduce High Volume Email service for sending internal messages beyond current limits, targeting line of business applications. This impacts organizations with high email volume needs. (GA: March CY2026) — Exchange

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified Teams app bar to create a cleaner and more focused experience.
item.description: Microsoft Teams is simplifying its app bar for a cleaner experience, making it easier to navigate apps. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Agent for GCC
item.description: The Researcher Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot will be available for business and enterprise users, assisting with complex tasks. This impacts users with the Copilot add-on license. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Feature conversations to all network members
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will allow featured conversations to be shared with all network members or just community members. This impacts users in public communities within Viva Engage. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent Updates
item.description: Microsoft Teams will have updates for channel agents, including new welcome messages, flexible channel creation, and improved member management. This affects Teams users and administrators managing channel settings. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for GCC-H and DoD environments
item.description: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection are now available for GCC-H and DoD environments, improving meeting hosting capabilities. This change affects users in government sectors. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft 365: Drawn electronic signatures with eSignature for Microsoft 365
item.description: Microsoft 365 will allow users to add drawn electronic signatures to PDFs using various input methods, expanding signature options. This affects all users who need to sign documents electronically. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Word

item.title: SharePoint: Admin policy for expiring "People in your organization" links
item.description: Administrators can now set policies to automatically expire 'People in your organization' sharing links after a specified period, enhancing data governance. This impacts all users sharing internal content. (GA: March CY2026) — OneDrive, SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics: Copilot adoption PBI version update including Power user insights.
item.description: The Copilot adoption Power BI report in Microsoft Viva will receive a user experience update and include new insights for power users. This affects users analyzing Copilot adoption. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Suspicious Call in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams now allows users to report suspicious calls, contributing to security measures against unwanted call activity. This feature empowers all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Defender for Office 365

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Activity in other accounts and organizations
item.description: Users can now view and respond to notifications across multiple Teams accounts without switching. This feature enhances workflow for users managing multiple tenants. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - Add Sample to Review Set
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery will allow users to add a sampled subset of search results to a review set, improving efficiency in data management. This change affects users involved in eDiscovery processes. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: Improved results when filtering your message list
item.description: Outlook for iOS will enhance message filtering to include older messages not currently synced, improving search capabilities. This change affects Outlook for iOS users. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice tethering
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces voice tethering to ensure captions and transcripts attribute spoken content to the correct signer during meetings. This change affects users who rely on sign language interpretation. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Say "Hey Copilot" to activate voice conversations with the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on Windows
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app on Windows will allow users to activate voice conversations by saying 'Hey Copilot'. This feature is designed for enterprise use and respects compliance settings. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Exchange: Exchange Online Moderation approval requests via Actionable Messages
item.description: Exchange Online Moderation now supports Actionable Messages, allowing moderators to approve or reject messages directly from Outlook. This update does not apply to mobile or Mac versions. (GA: March CY2026) — Exchange

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Image viewer improvements enable scrolling and jumping to original message
item.description: Teams is improving the image viewer to allow users to scroll through shared images and jump to the original message. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice and Face Enrollment Dashboard for Admins
item.description: Admins can now access a dashboard in the Teams Admin Center to monitor voice and facial profile enrollments for AI-enhanced meetings. This change impacts Teams administrators. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Broader access to M365 Copilot Chat insights
item.description: Microsoft Viva is expanding access to M365 Copilot Chat insights for tenants with fewer licenses, allowing broader tracking of adoption trends. This change affects administrators of smaller organizations. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
item.description: Microsoft 365's Copilot will simplify the Input Box by displaying added content as a pill instead of repeating it in prompts. This change affects all users utilizing the input feature. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Excel Agent
item.description: Excel Agent in Microsoft 365 helps users create charts and insights from data, streamlining data preparation and visualization. This feature is available to all Microsoft 365 users. (GA: March CY2026) — Excel, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): PowerPoint Agent
item.description: PowerPoint Agent assists users in creating presentations by streamlining research and formatting. This feature is available to all Microsoft 365 users. (GA: March CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: New Organization chart in the Profile Card for Web and Desktop
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing an organization chart in the profile card, allowing users to view reports and contextualize colleagues. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced AI governance for Glint Copilot
item.description: Viva Glint's Copilot will align with Microsoft's AI governance platform, centralizing access management and monitoring for AI features across Microsoft 365. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Outlook: Scheduling with Copilot chat in classic Outlook for Windows
item.description: Outlook allows users to schedule meetings directly from chat using Copilot, which finds available times and sends invites, available to Copilot license holders. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Prepare for meetings with Copilot in classic Outlook for Windows
item.description: Outlook for Windows is adding Copilot to help users prepare for meetings by summarizing context and tasks. This change affects Microsoft 365 users using classic Outlook for Windows. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Introducing a new URL click alert in Teams via Microsoft Defender for Office 365
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will provide a new alert for Teams that notifies security teams when a user clicks a malicious link. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Defender for Office 365

item.title: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
item.description: Microsoft Teams adds new quick view controls at the top of the chat list for easy access to mentions and followed threads, with customizable display options. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Audio recap language expansion
item.description: Teams will support audio recap in eight additional languages, enhancing accessibility for global users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Easily find unsent drafts
item.description: Teams introduces a Drafts quick view feature that helps users find, edit, and send unsent draft messages easily. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Choose Your Enter Key Behavior in Teams Chat
item.description: Teams now allows users to choose how the Enter key functions when composing messages, either sending or starting a new line. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generative-AI skills for Create in Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Government Clouds
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Government Clouds will enable users to create and edit various visual content using generative AI tools. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Annotations on Teams Single Window Sharing on Windows OS
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable presenters to share a single application window and allow participants to annotate on it, improving presentation engagement. This affects users conducting meetings or training sessions. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Live meetings indicator for channels
item.description: Teams will introduce a live meetings indicator in channels, helping users identify and join ongoing meetings easily. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Account Manager
item.description: Outlook introduces an Account Manager feature that allows users to view their Microsoft account details, profile picture, and add new accounts if allowed by their organization. (GA: February CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: One-step folder sharing
item.description: Outlook will allow users to share a folder in one step, automatically applying permissions to parent folders. This change simplifies the sharing process for all Outlook users. (GA: June CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Clear & Flag Actions in New Outlook
item.description: The new Outlook will introduce additional rule actions for message organization, including options to clear and flag messages. This affects users managing emails in the new Outlook. (GA: February CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Organization Evaluation Score for Apps and Agents
item.description: Microsoft Teams will automate the evaluation of apps and agents against organizational trust requirements, providing IT admins with evaluation scores and reports. This change impacts Teams administrators. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: New SlimCore-based optimization for Microsoft Teams in VDI - support for Windows endpoints on Omnissa environments
item.description: Microsoft Teams will optimize performance in VDI environments for Windows endpoints using a new media engine, enhancing quality and reliability. This affects users in VDI setups. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Expanded Conditions for Conditional Formatting in the New Outlook for Web and Windows
item.description: The new Outlook will offer expanded Conditional Formatting options to highlight emails based on various criteria, aiding users in organizing their inboxes. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: January CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Play a Sound Rule
item.description: Outlook will allow users to set rules that play a sound or show alerts for specific incoming emails, helping them stay informed. This feature impacts users managing their email notifications. (GA: January CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Rule to display desktop alert
item.description: Users can create rules in Outlook to trigger desktop alerts for specific emails, enhancing their ability to monitor important messages. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: January CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Voice chats can reference Memory
item.description: In Copilot voice chats, users can receive responses based on their stored memories, though they cannot edit these memories during chats. This impacts users utilizing voice chat features. (GA: January CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot voice support in Word & PowerPoint.
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint, allowing users to brainstorm and create content verbally. This affects users of Word and PowerPoint. (GA: December CY2025) — PowerPoint, Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Metadata understanding support for queries scoped to SharePoint document libraries or folders
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will now support column metadata for queries in SharePoint document libraries or folders, improving the relevance of search results. This change affects users utilizing Copilot with SharePoint. (GA: November CY2025) — SharePoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable watermarks for AI-generated content for M365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will add watermarks to AI-generated content, including video and images. This affects users creating AI-generated materials. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Clipchamp, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
item.description: The Teams Meet app will allow users to discover and organize events within their organization. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery - Generate keyword query language from natural language prompt in eDiscovery with Copilot for Security
item.description: Copilot for Security in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal will translate natural language prompts into keyword queries for eDiscovery. This affects users involved in compliance and eDiscovery. (GA: January CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: New SlimCore-based optimization for Microsoft Teams in VDI - support for MacOS on Citrix and Azure Virtual Desktops/Windows 365
item.description: Microsoft Teams will optimize performance in VDI environments for MacOS using a new media engine, improving quality and reliability. This change affects Mac users in VDI setups. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Entra: App Deactivation
item.description: Admins can now deactivate apps in Microsoft Entra without deleting them, blocking new token requests and user sign-ins. This impacts app owners and admins managing app access. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Entra

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Word Agent
item.description: Word Agent in Microsoft 365 helps users with research and formatting in Word, allowing for multi-turn chat to refine drafts. This affects all Microsoft 365 users. (GA: February CY2026) — Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)
